title: A Tiny Warning Before a Marching Host
intro: Step into a valley where a mighty ruler and a vast host are approaching, and picture a tiny traveler giving a warning that saves an entire community. As the threatened community reaches shelter, the danger passes by. Follow the clues to identify the overlooked figure behind that warning.
clues: I am among the small creatures associated with a ruler's kingdom.
My community lives in dwellings inside a valley, where one of us can call to the others.
We face a threat from that ruler and the armies traveling with the ruler.
I am the one who calls my community to enter their dwellings and warns us not to be crushed unknowingly.
The ruler is Sulayman, and my species is among the creatures placed under his command.
I am the ant of that valley; after my warning, we entered our dwellings and escaped the crushing that would otherwise have caught us unaware.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
